QuestInfo.name: Who Does Cassandra Like?
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra actually knows that Inkwell likes her, but her heart belongs to someone else... Who could it be?\n
QuestInfo.1: Turns out Cassandra likes sharp dressers like Gaga! Help Cassandra with her confession by eliminating the Cake Monster.\n
QuestInfo.2: You helped the cause of true love by eliminating the Cake Monster! Cassandra's probably going to need more help, though...\n

0.0: Oh, Valentine's Day... The ONE perfect day of the year for confessing love is here! Of course, I always receive a mountain of chocolates every year, and yes, I know Inkwell is after me this year, but... Honestly, there's someone who's caught my eye. Wanna know who?

yes.0: Hee hee. You see, I'm really into Gaga!
yes.1: I'm all about sharp-looking, intelligent men. Who else could fit that bill than Gaga? That suit, that smile... Ooooh! Isn't he so hot? I really want to give him something this year, but the Cake Monster took all the chocolates I saved up! Can you beat that thing up and get my chocolate back?

no.0: Hmph. I thought you would care more about me than that...

1.0: Did you eliminate the Cake Monster?

yes.0: Thanks! This is just what I need to finish my gift. I could use more help, if you have time...

item.0: I've seen that frosted fiend stomping around still...hurry up and beat it!
